mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (monetary policy rate) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases risk-free rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal requires both series to be rising above their 12-month moving averages.
failure_condition: The interaction of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above their 12-month MAs does not produce negative 60-day returns (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (quarterly GDP growth > 2.0% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 5 trading days due to robust corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past 6 months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month low, it signals an imminent economic contraction that increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 12-month low (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both series to be falling below their 6-month moving averages.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS below their 6-month MAs does not produce negative 20-day returns (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to central bank tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
